autoLearnDesc: Learn from the tasks related to you and generate knowledge suggestions.

featureSwitch.description: When off, automatic reading and organization of general long-term memory stops. Existing memory remains available for manual editing.
featureSwitch.saveFailed: Failed to save the long-term memory setting. Please try again.
featureSwitch.title: Use long-term memory automatically

conflict.description: This file was updated by another task or page while you were editing. Choose how to continue without losing the latest content.
conflict.mergeDescription: Non-overlapping changes are merged automatically. Overlapping changes are placed in the editor with conflict markers for review before saving.
conflict.mergeHasConflicts: A merge draft was created. Resolve the conflict markers before saving.
conflict.mergeReady: The latest content was merged. Review it before saving.
conflict.title: File content has changed

globalEditor.editLoadFailed: Unable to load the latest content. Please try again.
globalEditor.emptyDescription: Add information that should remain useful across different tasks.

guide.description: This file stores personal information that should remain useful across tasks. The system reads it when relevant to respond with your preferences and background in mind.
guide.notRecommendedDescription: Passwords, verification codes, access tokens, temporary instructions for a single task, or unverified and outdated information.
guide.recommendedDescription: Stable identity details, preferred names, personal preferences, recurring work habits, and communication or output requirements you want followed over time.
guide.title: What this file is for

globalEditor.placeholder: Record user information that should be retained long term

globalMemoryDesc: $t(common:platform.name) will read the content in memory to provide personalized responses.
